name: logo-land
description: Create logos and app icons with native Codex images, compare multiple projects with exact originals, and carry your decisions into focused revisions.

interface.shortDescription: Logos and app icons start with a conversation.
interface.longDescription: Create eight logo types and six app icon styles through conversation. Compare candidates across saved projects with exact prompts, original PNGs and illustrative app or header previews. Keep selection reasons and features to preserve alongside focused revision requests. Refine saved images and export reviewed artwork with color evidence; platform layers and store approval are separate work.
defaultPrompt: $logo-land Help me create a logo that fits my brand.
$logo-land Create six independent IP character candidates for my reading app, using three directions.
$logo-land Create a centered notes-app monogram using the exact Korean text 메모 on a solid cream background.
Keep #247A52 and suggest warmer companion colors for the selected logo.
Create a symbol-plus-text logo with the symbol above the exact brand name.
Create a transparent PNG logo and preserve intentional white lettering.
Resume my saved logo project and export the selected reviewed PNG.
